about: SPHEREx releases at NASA IRSA and how recent WANDERERS' prepared targets are. Written by pipeline/spherex_releases.py; read by app/release.js and pipeline/fetch.py.

releases.name: spherex_dr1

releases_source: IRSA SIA collection list (astroquery Irsa.list_collections, servicetype SIA, filter spherex)
synced_source: pipeline/spherex_releases.py synced: fetch.py and analyze.py rebuilt 6 of 11 prepared targets
